verdict.rationale: Bento's own docs say developers see cost per run out of the box, and the CLI mirrors dashboard analytics, so it has a first-party cost view at the run level. That is a single thin mention, and the other dimensions the story asks for are not documented. Missing for 10: token usage metrics, breakdown by model, time-period aggregation in dashboards, per-request granularity distinct from per-run, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: you see cost per run, tool failure rates, drift over prompt versions, and regressions across deploys out of the box.
Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI: triage issues, read runs, inspect signals, pull analytics.
